diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this duplicates the existing implicit dependency: the provisioner reads the cluster endpoint.
